claim: On April 21, 2025 the default shard limits for data streams in Provisioned capacity mode were increased from 200 to 1,000 shards or 6,000 shards per account for all Regions other than US East (N. Virginia), US West (Oregon) and Europe (Ireland).

evidence.quote: The default shard limits have also been increased from 200 to 1,000 shards or 6,000 shards per account for all other regions.

Amazon Kinesis Data Streams now offers significantly higher default shard limits for data streams in Provisioned capacity mode, increasing from 500 to 20,000 shards per AWS account in the US East (N. Virginia), US West (Oregon), and Europe (Ireland) regions.
You can view the new defaults for all regions and request further increases via the Service Quotas console.

evidence.heading: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams increases default shard limits to up to 20,000 per AWS account
